title: Free Super-Specialty Medical Camp
summary: A Free Super-Specialty Medical Camp was organised on 23 Oct 26 at Gram Panchayat Office, Dehjani, Tal-Vikramgad, Dist-Palghar, jointly by Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-e-Punjab…
description: A Free Super-Specialty Medical Camp was organised on 23 Oct 26 at Gram Panchayat Office, Dehjani, Tal-Vikramgad, Dist-Palghar, jointly by Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-e-Punjab, Rotary Club of Bombay Kandivali and Rotary Club of Boisar–Tarapur, with support from Aastha Hospital, Manor, and Adhikari Lifeline Hospital, Boisar. From 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., villagers received free consultations in gynaecology, paediatrics, general medicine, eye examinations, cataract screening and dental care. Medicines were provided by Rotary Club of Mumbai Ghatkopar West, while nutritional supplements were supplied by Chingari Shakti Foundation. Dr. Praveen Vaishya, President of Rotary Club of Boisar–Tarapur, actively participated, while Past President Rakesh Mishra contributed to the project's success. Medical services were coordinated by Dr. Avinash Sonawane. The initiative improved rural access to specialist healthcare, medicines and nutritional support, reflecting Rotary's motto, “Service Above Self.”
location: Gram Panchayat Office, Dehjani, Taluka Vikramgad, District Palghar, Boisar (W), Maharashtra
